# testing_x_pagination_with_request_array (Resource)

XPaginationWithRequestArray Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_pagination_with_request_array" "my_xpaginationwithrequestarray" {
  id = "...my_id..."
  tags = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource ID

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Configurable array that exists ONLY in request, not in response

### Read-Only

- `items` (List of String) Paginated array of items in the response

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_pagination_with_request_array.my_testing_x_pagination_with_request_array
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_pagination_with_request_array.my_testing_x_pagination_with_request_array "..."
```
